name: Cover: Creative Mode
description: A poster cover: on the left an ink rule leading into a monospace capitals tagline, a heavy all-caps headline and a paragraph; on the right one solid green poster frame holding a hot-pink switch block with a hard-edged shadow; a monospace footer with the series name left and the page number right. A centred title slide would lose the weight of the colour-block poster and the tension between the two sides.

kicker.hint: monospace capitals tagline after the ink rule, filled automatically from the first clause of occasion (up to 10 characters)

title.hint: claim headline, 2 lines, up to 14 characters; *keyword* turns orange

subtitle.hint: a paragraph bottom left, up to 3 lines and 60 characters

brand.hint: footer left: series or deck name, filled automatically from the series name of the story title (before the colon)

page.hint: footer right: page number, filled automatically ("01 / 08")

subtitle.value: Six decks last quarter averaged four revision rounds, three of them layout only; confirm the story first and those rounds disappear.

brand.value: Confirm the story before the slides
